column6: desc
Walking backward, aeroplane style: both arms raised as wings – tilting from side to side
Walking backward, akimbo style: hands on hips
Walking backward, angry style: swing lower arms aggressively - fists closed
Walking backward, arms above head style: arms raised straight above head
Walking backward, arms behind back style: hands clasped behind back
Walking backward, arms by side style: keep arms fixed by side and do not move them
Walking backward, arms folded style: right arm folded over left
Walking backward, balance style: arms out to side for balance - tilting side to side
Walking backward, beat chest style: beat chest while moving normally
Walking backward, bent forward style: tilt torso forwards
Walking backward, bent knees style: bend knees as much as possible
Walking backward, big steps style: as large steps as possible
Walking backward, bouncy left style: step normally with right foot but spring off left foot
Walking backward, bouncy right style: step normally with left foot but spring off right foot
Walking backward, cat style: use hands as paws - step opposite hand and foot
Walking backward, chicken style: bob head - arms as wings
Walking backward, cross over style: step each foot in front of other leg
Walking backward, crouched style: squat slightly and bend back
Walking backward, crowd avoidance style: occasionally turning shoulders or turn sideways to avoid others
Walking backward, depressed style: head bowed arms swinging
Walking backward, dinosaur style: like a t-rex arms close to body dinosaur posture
Walking backward, drag left leg style: drag left foot along the floor
Walking backward, drag right leg style: drag right foot along the floor
Walking backward, drunk style: stumbling around at random. Various foot step sizes and arm motions
Walking backward, duck foot style: toes pointing inwards
Walking backward, elated style: swing arms with spring
Walking backward, fairy steps style: one foot in front of the other so the heel touches the toe
Walking backward, flapping style: flap arms as wings on tiptoes
Walking backward, flick legs style: knees together and flick legs to sides as moving
Walking backward, followed style: check behind occasionally
Walking backward, graceful arms style: one arm across chest the other extended walk tall
Walking backward, hands between legs style: bent back – legs wide - hands swing between legs
Walking backward, hands in pockets style: place hands in pockets and walk and run
Walking backward, heavyset style: walking as a muscle man tensed biceps
Walking backward, high knees style: lift knees high but only knees – not marching
Walking backward, in the dark style: feeling around as if in darkness
Walking backward, karate chop style: open hands swing hand with each step to do a karate chop
Walking backward, kick style: kick with every step
Walking backward, lawn mower style: roll hands over one another like disco move and tilt torso forwards and then back
Walking backward, lean back style: bent backwards
Walking backward, lean left style: normal motion upperbody tilted right
Walking backward, lean right style: normal motion upperbody tilted left
Walking backward, left hop style: hop on left foot
Walking backward, legs apart style: legs relatively straight wide apart
Walking backward, limp left style: keep left leg straight and limp
Walking backward, limp right style: keep right leg straight and limp
Walking backward, look up style: tilt head to look at ceiling
Walking backward, lunge style: wide step bend knee every step in lunge position
Walking backward, march style: high knees swing arms at elbows
Walking backward, monk style: interlock hands in front of pelvis head slightly bowed
Walking backward, morris style: swing hands side to side as if waving hankies. Bouncy/skipping footsteps
Walking backward, neutral style: normal walking
Walking backward, old style: hunchbacked move very slowly
Walking backward, on heels style: walk on heels with toes raised
Walking backward, on phone left style: holding phone in left
Walking backward, on phone right style: holding phone in right
Walking backward, on toes bent forward style: as bent forward style but on tip toes
Walking backward, on toes crouched style: as crouched style but on tip toes
Walking backward, pendulum hands style: squat slightly make right angle with elbows and swing hands freely
Walking backward, penguin style: waddle with feet close together
Walking backward, pigeon toed style: toes turned inwards
Walking backward, proud style: straight back arms move as if marching to a lesser degree
Walking backward, punch style: punch with every step
Walking backward, quail style: arms straight by sides slightly back very small quick steps
Walking backward, raised left arm style: raise left arm perpendicular to body
Walking backward, raised right arm style: raise right arm perpendicular to body
Walking backward, right hop style: hop on right foot
Walking backward, roadrunner style: arms behind as wings pick up knees - bent a little
Walking backward, robot style: stiff movements arms bending at elbows
Walking backward, rocket style: bent to flat back with hands behind as thrusters
Walking backward, rushed style: rushing about swinging arms for extra momentum
Walking backward, shielded left style: squat down with left arm raised in block as if holding a shield above head. Right arm as if holding a sword
Walking backward, shielded right style: squat down with right arm raised in block as if holding a shield above head. Left arm as if holding a sword
Walking backward, skip style: skipping like a child
Walking backward, slide feet style: barely lift feet off the floor/kick into floor
Walking backward, star style: wide arms and legs. Arms slightly below horizontal
Walking backward, start stop style: pause briefly after step
Walking backward, stiff style: stiff limbs arms straight
Walking backward, strutting style: with swagger leant slightly back arms swinging freely
Walking backward, superman style: right arm raised like superman flying
Walking backward, swat style: as if holding a rifle and raiding a building
Walking backward, sweep style: sweeping with a broom while moving
Walking backward, swimming style: breaststroke walking
Walking backward, swing arms round style: swing arms round body (right in front left at back then switch)
Walking backward, swing shoulders style: rotate torso and shoulders left to right and back
Walking backward, teapot style: one arm on hip other arm raised
Walking backward, tiptoe style: walk on toes with heels raised
Walking backward, together step style: step left foot - then together – then right foot
Walking backward, two foot jump style: feet together and jump
Walking backward, walking stick left style: walk with a stick – used broom handle
Walking backward, walking stick right style: walk with a stick – used broom handle
Walking backward, waving style: waving at somebody else at random
Walking backward, whirl arms style: windmill arms
Walking backward, wide legs style: legs apart motions
Walking backward, wiggle hips style: hands raised in front of body wiggle hips side to side
Walking backward, wild arms style: swing arms much more than normal almost punching into the air
Walking backward, wild legs style: kick legs into the air with each step
Walking backward, zombie style: arms in front like zombie
